scope: local/static QA only; no WordPress write

tests.mutation_observer_scope: childList + subtree; helper attribute mutations do not themselves create addedNodes, so the helper does not self-trigger an attribute loop

static_scope_review.contact_semantics: aria-label only on existing tel/mailto links
static_scope_review.form_semantics: aria-label/describedby/group relationships only; no field values, validation, submission or SMTP behavior changed

deployment_preconditions: Fresh page264 hash must still equal the documented baseline or the live drift must be reconciled first.
Fresh WPVibe quota must fit install/readback/frontend verification plus D11 10-call reserve and retry margin.
Use a supported plugin-aware page-scoped runtime path; do not inject through unrelated global CSS or raw database mutation.
After deployment, verify source/target accessibility tree and Elementor/editor lifecycle; static lint is not frontend acceptance.
